condition: When the input is empty along the filter axis and zi is given, lfilter returns an uninitialised zf for IIR filters or raises ValueError for FIR filters, and sosfilt raises a reshape ValueError.
workaround: Check for an empty block before calling (x.shape[axis] == 0 or x.size == 0). If it is empty, return an empty output and a copy of zi instead of calling lfilter/sosfilt.
